Docket 1.3.89

**Three more findings that were wrong about real sites, now fixed.**

- *"Pages are blocked from indexing" for tag archives you blocked on purpose.*
  Keeping thin tag and author pages out of search is standard advice, and
  counting them made the finding look far more serious than it was. They are
  now left out of the count and named separately, like carts and confirmation
  pages. Category pages are still counted, because on a shop they are usually
  meant to rank.
- *Health and service explainers reported as competing pages.* Articles written
  in one house style — "<condition>: causes, symptoms and treatment",
  "<treatment>: types and benefits" — share those words and nothing else. They
  are no longer grouped as pages chasing the same search.
- *"Your brand name appears 3 different ways" because of a logo's alt text.* An
  alt written like a file name — your name run together, then "logo", then
  which version of the image it is — is recognised as your name.

99 checks across 13 areas.
